snippet.title: Morbid Mailroom Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Here! : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3930970/Morbid_Mailroom/

In a claymation prison for occult offenders, you are the package inspector. Search packages for hidden contraband, coded letters, and cursed objects. Balance duty, compassion, and survival as you decide what reaches the inmates and what burns in the incinerator. Your choices cannot be undone.
